force.title: The Great Consolidation
force.signature: Capital rolls up fragmented Main Street — PE, franchises, REITs, and scale leaders absorb the independents, and financialization wins while owner-operators exit.

A \u00b7 Rolling up healthcare: PE rolls up practices and clinics, chasing scale and billing power.
Med-tech and generics consolidate to survive pricing pressure.
B \u00b7 Franchising Main Street: Franchising and PE turn local services into scaled, financialized platforms.
Professional and boring-but-essential services get rolled into regional platforms.
C \u00b7 Scale in retail & food: A few big-box leaders capture the category; independents fold.
Distribution and production consolidate; craft and independents get bought or squeezed.
D \u00b7 Capital owns the assets: Institutional capital owns the real assets and rents them back.
Rights and catalogs get financialized into yield-bearing assets.
E \u00b7 The big picture: Capstone: capital rolls up the fragmented economy; scale and financialization win, independent owners exit.
